path.description: absolute path of the clone on its host

host.description: local or a host of hosts.yaml

fallback.description: worker kind used when worker_kind is unavailable

max_parallel.description: runs of this project at once

post_merge_hook.description: command run after a merge, under the project lock

pre_go_check.description: command whose output goes with a ready PR before the owner's go

worktree_dir.description: absolute directory of the runs' worktrees; default the checkout's parent
